label.zh: 护盾降下后的四种发现
label.en: The four discoveries once the shield falls

note.zh: 专项完成后随机四选一（基础权重各25，部分带修正）：封存舰队 / 知识宝库 / 囚徒图伯雷克 / 流放者归来。
note.en: A random pick of four when the project completes (base weight 25 each, some modified): Mothballed Fleet / Vault of Knowledge / The Prisoner / The Exiles Return.

notes.zh: 评注：勘测到被衰落帝国护盾（pc_shielded、fallen_shield_world）笼罩的行星时（on_survey_planet → 隐藏事件 galactic_features.299，且游戏已过去至少一年、尚无该专项）弹出（events/galactic_features_events.txt:150-224）。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when a planet wrapped in a Fallen Empire shield (pc_shielded, fallen_shield_world) is surveyed (on_survey_planet -> hidden galactic_features.299, once the game is at least a year old and the project is not running) (events/galactic_features_events.txt:150-224).

scope.zh: 触发、专项、四种随机发现及图伯雷克对话已核对。
scope.en: The trigger, the project, the four random discoveries and the Tuborek conversation were checked.
